chunks: My father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with them) narrated; Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar and Ahmad ibn Idris both narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari; Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated from his father, from Bakr ibn Salih, from al-Ja'fari, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say:
Trim your nails on Tuesday, take a bath on Wednesday, get your blood-letting needs done on Thursday, and perfume yourselves with your best perfume on Friday.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended weekly schedule for personal hygiene and grooming in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) outlines a structured weekly routine for personal hygiene, assigning specific grooming practices to each day to maintain ritual purity and physical well-being. This tradition reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating bodily care with spiritual discipline, culminating in the use of perfume on Friday to honor the congregational prayer and the day of gathering.
